correctness.rationale: The cited geometric model is irreducible; over the affine Hermitian curve, L(t)=t+t^(q²) is finite étale in each coordinate, giving a smooth affine cover of degree q⁴. If L(t)=0 then t^(q²)=−t and t belongs to F_(q⁴), while its only root in F_(q²) is zero in odd characteristic. Thus L permutes F_(q^m) whenever 4∤m, giving equality of the affine counts. At infinity the q+1 points have slopes α with α^(q+1)=−1 and α in F_(q²); the ordinary branches have distinct tangent labels β in ker L. One can see the labels directly by taking t=1/y, x=α/t+w: after canceling the leading terms and multiplying the equation by t^(q³), its reduction at t=0 is α^q L(w)=0 with nonzero derivative in w. Frobenius therefore acts on the labels by (α,β)↦(α^q,β^q). When 4∤m only β=0 contributes, so the counts agree after adding the normalized points at infinity. In degree 4, L maps onto F_(q²) with q² preimages per value; the q³−q affine Hermitian points each lift to q⁴ points and the boundary adds q²(q+1), reproducing the cited count q⁷−q⁵+q³+q². The Hermitian curve has q+1 points over F_q (a smooth conic on those points) and is maximal over F_(q²); its eigenvalues square to −q and occur with opposite signs in equal multiplicities. The projective map yields the Hermitian Jacobian up to isogeny as a factor over F_q: norm after pullback is multiplication by q⁴, still an isogeny in characteristic p. Thus the complementary Weil numerator is integral. Its formal logarithm is the difference-count series divided by the extension degrees, so it and its exponential lie in the T⁴ subring. Degree comparison and (N_X(4)−N_H(4))/4 give the asserted degree and coefficient. For β=0, the fixed α satisfy α²=−1, yielding e_q, and the rest have period two. For β≠0 the second power of Frobenius negates β, so all those pairs have exact period four. This yields the stated finite-étale zeta factors.
residual_risks: The frozen checker uses q equal to p in its samples, not non-prime q; the proof uses F_(q²), F_(q⁴), and the intersection formula for arbitrary odd prime powers. Boundary enumeration in the checker presupposes the tangent label formula. No full Q_q, characteristic-two analogue or formal verification is asserted.

value.rationale: The known input count in one maximally split extension and the geometric list of branches alone are not the value claim. The extension-wide result identifies exactly which degrees can contribute to the complementary trace and constrains the allowed coefficient support of a very large Weil numerator for a studied cover. The first coefficient and the arithmetic splitting of the distinguished boundary give usable exact data for further zeta calculations, even without an expression for all the remaining coefficients.
residual_risks: Possible nonzero traces are restricted to multiples of four, not asserted nonzero in every such degree; no higher coefficients of Q_q are computed.
